relevant_files.purpose: Demo/placeholder adapter script developers replace with their real adapter; demonstrates full bridge API (showAlert/showPrompt/showSingleSelection/saveImportedCourses/savePresetTimeSlots/saveCourseConfig/notifyTaskCompletion) and the course-object JSON schema with inline sample courses (lines 93-294) and preset time slots (lines 315-332)

Page-side bridge shim emulating the Android shiguangBridge/shiguangBridgePromise; contains the authoritative course-data validation contract (required fields, custom-time HH:mm regex, section fields) and CourseConfigJsonModel defaults
Service worker caching courses/timeSlots/config from bridge calls and merging them into the downloadable CourseTableExport.json consumed by the app's file import
Injects injected_bridge.js + school.js into the logged-in jw page and relays ANDROID_BRIDGE_CALL messages to the extension; the 'runs the adapter inside a real jiaowu session' execution model

Confirms the workflow: replace school.js with your adapter code, run against the logged-in jiaowu page, export CourseTableExport.json which is compatible with the app's file import; Alpha-stage adapter testing

protocol_approach: This is a Chrome MV3 extension test harness, not an adapter collection: the developer pastes their JS adapter into school.js, the extension injects it into the logged-in jiaowu page alongside injected_bridge.js (a JS shim emulating the app's Android bridge), and the adapter's output is captured via shiguangBridgePromise.saveImportedCourses/savePresetTimeSlots/saveCourseConfig, merged, and downloaded as CourseTableExport.json ({courses, timeSlots, config}) for import into the app. It therefore fixes the ADAPTER OUTPUT CONTRACT — course objects with name/teacher/position/day/weeks and either startSection/endSection or isCustomTime+customStartTime/customEndTime — but the committed school.js is demo data and the repo contains zero jiaowu endpoint fixtures: no Kingosoft TaskActivity HTML, no dgData table, no CourseFormTable.
verdict_reason: Repo contains zero jiaowu protocol fixtures (grep for kingo/taskactivity/dgdata/courseformtable/jwglxt across all JS: no hits) — school.js is demo data — so it cannot corroborate the specific TaskActivity/dgData/CourseFormTable parsing claims; but it independently confirms the harness architecture around which the shiguang_warehouse adapters are written (JS adapter executed in-browser against the logged-in jiaowu page, emitting the {courses, timeSlots, config} JSON contract), which is consistent with and indirectly supports that POSITIVE verdict.

sleepy_claim_check.shiguang_warehouse 适配协议族佐证: INDIRECT only. The harness corroborates the workflow and output contract of shiguang_warehouse's JS adapters (browser-injected bridge scripts producing courses/timeSlots/config JSON importable by the app) — notably the course model (day 1-7, startSection/endSection, weeks array, isCustomTime with strict HH:mm regex) matches the WakeUp/shiguang adapter family Sleepy ports. However it holds no inline Kingosoft TaskActivity / dgData / CourseFormTable fixtures, so the day=floor(idx/unitCount)+1, rowspan, and CourseFormTable claims must rest on the shiguang_warehouse repo verdict itself; this repo neither confirms nor contradicts them.
